messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager — high 5xx rate for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (threshold breach). Alerting Anna (oncall).
Anna: I'm oncall, looking into it. seeing spikes in 524/525 from edge.
Derek: same from our side — TLS handshake failures and DNS timeouts in a subset of CF POPs. grabbing logs.
Anna: links: https://app.monitoring.example.com/alert/12345 — error rate jumped at 05:04 UTC.
Derek: log sample:```[proxy] 10.0.1.2 -> edge: TLS handshake failed: remote error: tls: handshake failure```
Derek: curl to a failing host shows:```curl -v https://api.redwood.example -H 'Host: api.redwood.example' * SSL connection using TLSv1.2 / * server certificate verification OK * schannel: next InitializeSecurityContext failed: SEC_E_ILLEGAL_MESSAGE (0x80090326) - curl: (35) OpenSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to...```
Cloudflare Status Bot: Cloudflare reports degraded performance in eu-west and some DNS propagation delays — https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/abcd1234 (investigating).
Ciara: can we confirm it's CF and not our origin? traceroute shows early failure at CF edge IPs.
Anna: I see increased NXDOMAIN/timeout from our resolver pool for api.redwood.example when queries are proxied via provider A. direct queries to authoritative show normal answers.
Derek: hypothesis: Cloudflare pop-level authz/edge TLS misconfig + partial DNS propagation. Some requests hitting fallback path that expects mutual TLS causing handshake errors.
Rachel: Impact check — Support Ops reports about ~12% API request failures for customers in EU region, mostly non-authenticated generation calls. No enterprise customers in P0 impacted yet.
Support Ops: we already have a few tickets from devs complaining about 5xx bursts and SDK retry storms. prepping a status update.
Anna: mitigation options: 1) Route traffic to alternate CF POPs via load-balancer geo-policy, 2) Bypass CF for critical routes and hit origin directly via LB public IP (risk: expose origin to internet), 3) Ask CF to failover/pop reconfigure.
Derek: quick test — switching our LB pool to prefer us-east for new flows reduces error rate in canary. rolling canary to 10% traffic now.
Anna: executing rollback route change to add fallback pool:```curl -X POST "https://console.internal.lb/api/v1/route/sets" -d '{"id":"api-eu","fallback":"pool-us-east","weight":10}'```
Oncall Bot: Deploy bot: route change applied by Anna at 05:18 UTC.
Derek: canary looks good, error rate down from 18% to 3% in the canary group. increasing to 40%.
Ciara: opening ticket with Cloudflare: CF-INC-2026-558; attaching handshake logs and resolver traces. requesting expedited roll-forward on affected POPs.
Cloudflare Status Bot: CF update: engineers are rolling configuration rollback on affected POPs, ETA 35-50m.
Support Ops: drafting status page message: "We are experiencing elevated API errors in EU region due to third-party CDN/DNS disruptions. We have applied routing fallbacks to mitigate; customers may see increased latency. Working with Cloudflare for full resolution."
Rachel: Customer communication: for customers with SSO we saw a small spike of auth failures due to edge TLS errors — recommend retry/backoff and we are monitoring.
Anna: decision: keep fallback routing in place for now, monitor for 1h, do not expose origin directly until CF confirms. escalation path: if errors >10% for 30m we escalate to engineering pager and consider origin bypass.
Derek: creating a short packet capture and collecting TLS traces: ```tcpdump -i eth0 host 203.0.113.45 and port 443 -w /tmp/cf-handshake.pcap``` — saved to /artifacts/2162501234/
Ciara: adding DNS logs and resolver histograms to the incident folder.
Support Ops: posted status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2162501234 — message sent at 05:25 UTC.
Anna: on-call handoff: I'm handing off to Ciara at 05:50 UTC for the next 2 hours. key actions: monitor CF ticket, keep fallback route, coordinate with support on any enterprise customers.
Ciara: taking over. bookmarked CF ticket and files. I'll push updates and escalate if CF ETA slips beyond 1h.
Derek: post-incident actions: collect config snapshots of LB, CF POP list, rollout timeline. prepare a postmortem and eval fallback automation (auto-failover when edge TLS error rate >X).
Support Ops: drafting canned reply for customers: "We're investigating elevated API errors in EU due to a CDN provider disruption. We've applied mitigations and will update in 30 minutes. If you're seeing errors include request ids and region."
Cloudflare Status Bot: CF update: partial remediation applied, monitoring shows improvement in affected POPs.
Ciara: monitoring shows global error rate down to baseline ~0.8%. leaving fallback in place for 45m, then plan to gradually remove.
Anna: thanks team. will include CF ticket ID, screenshots, and timelines in the postmortem.
Support Ops: closing loop with reported tickets — added note about workaround and expected timeline.
Ciara: incident resolved for now. moving to follow-up.
Oncall Bot: Incident closed at 06:45 UTC (duration ~1h 21m) — severity: Sev2, root cause: Cloudflare edge configuration + DNS propagation issues.
